explanation: Agar comes from red algae. Its jellies set as they cool through about 40 °C and stay firm on a hot day, when gelatin would melt.

claims.text: Agar is extracted from seaweed, specifically red algae.
Agar is not made from apple peel, cassava root or tree sap.
Agar gels set as they cool to roughly 32 to 40 °C.
Agar gels stay solid until heated to about 85 °C, while gelatin gels melt at around body temperature.
